question: What cosmological fact follows after the Brahma egg has been described?
premises: Others explain the distinguishing terms as preventing egg-ness in the wrong cases.
The Brahma egg has already been described.
Beyond that egg there are one hundred Rudras.
inference: Therefore the text now turns from the Brahma egg to the hundred Rudras beyond it.
uncertainties: The verse functions as a bridge, so its full sense depends on verse 180.
plain_english: Others say the distinguishing terms were used to prevent egg-ness from being wrongly applied; and once the Brahma egg has been described, the text notes that beyond it there are one hundred Rudras.
